hooks.text: 诸神黄昏令世界树几乎失去维系九界的能量，少数英雄必须在世界终结中求生。
hooks.excerpt: During Ragnarok, Yggdrasil, the Tree of Life, lost almost all of its energy to sustain the Nine Realms. Only a few heroes will be able to survive the End of the World.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 角色星座能力树负责单人属性成长，世界树则承担跨局元进度，再由角色精通继续提升潜力。
hooks.excerpt: Skill tree in the form of character constellations, to improve the stats of each survivor. Yggdrasil as a meta-progress tree to boost different features that will make you feel more powerful in your adventure. Character Masteries to upgrade your characters to their maximum potential.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 九张地图分别取材于北欧九界，十余名角色各自拥有专属技能和武器。
hooks.excerpt: 9 maps, inspired by each realm of Norse mythology. 10+ characters, with exclusive skills and weapons.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
